_note: Hand-curated FUNCTIONAL role of each component IN a given character, overlaid onto composes edges by build-graph.py. Keyed char → component → role. Values: 'semantic' (义符, contributes meaning), 'phonetic' (声符, contributes sound), 'form' (记号, shape-only residue incl. stroke-level parts). A pair absent here = not yet typed (edge stays role-less). Structural decomposition (WHICH parts) is fetched into decomposition.json; this is the separate, non-clobbered functional layer (WHAT each part does). build-graph.py warns on unknown role values and on entries matching no real edge.
